fields.System.Title: INV-2 — Movement ledger
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Record every change of stock as an immutable entry, so that any number can be explained and any
balance can be rebuilt.

Scope

In. Writing movements, querying the ledger, tracing a movement back to the document that
caused it.

Out. Editing or deleting movements. This never happens — a mistake is corrected by an
opposite entry.

Design notes

Every movement is a transfer between two locations, one of which may be virtual. A receipt
is VIRT-SUPPLIER -> RECV-01. A write-off is PICK-A-01 -> VIRT-LOSS. Quantity is always
positive; direction comes from the two locations.

The payoff: total quantity across all locations never changes. Any change in the total means
something created or destroyed stock outside the ledger, which is exactly the bug you want to
detect.

Append-only. No updates, no deletes, ever. This is the one part of the system that gets
easier to reason about as it grows, because it never changes shape.

reference_type and reference_id tie a movement to the pick task, receipt, or count that
caused it. Without this, a ledger entry is a fact with no story.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| A balance changed with no movement written | [doc 09 §2.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Movement written outside the business transaction | [doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Movement with no reason code or actor | [doc 03 §8](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
